 Advertisement Updated: 9:02 PM CDT Oct 31, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Lynne Keenum Producer Riley Conlon Digital Producer Multiple people injured in shooting near Legion Field following Magic City Classic
 Updated: 9:02 PM CDT Oct 31, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Lynne Keenum Producer Riley Conlon Digital Producer BIRMINGHAM, Ala. — Multiple people have been injured in a shooting near Legion Field in Birmingham.
 Shots were fired shortly before 8 p.m. on Graymont Avenue West, not long after the end of the Magic City Classic game. Tailgating festivities were still underway in the area.
 Advertisement >> YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD: Community coverage from WVTM 13 
 Information is limited at this time. Police say multiple people were wounded by gunfire, but that no conditions for any of the victims could be confirmed as of 8:45 p.m.
 All Magic City Classic tailgating has been suspended. Police ask that anyone in attendance leave the stadium property as soon as possible and not return.
 WVTM 13 has a crew en route to the scene.
 This is a developing story and will be updated as information becomes available. Stay updated on the latest stories with the WVTM 13 app. You can download it here .
